name: tr_derozan
caption:
IF DEMAR HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

🐶 Growlithe: extremely loyal, barks at anything to protect its trainer. Drafted 9th in 2009, 9 seasons with us
🔥 Houndoom: the pack picks its leader by fighting it out. 4 All-Star games with us, a starter in 2017
🌋 Darmanitan: its internal fire burns hot enough to wreck a dump truck. 52 points on New Year's Day 2018
⚡ Boltund: can run nonstop for days. By 2018, our leader in games, minutes and wins
🐺 Lycanroc: raised young, it never betrays its trainer. July 2018, we traded him for Kawhi
🌟 Entei: blasts fire that consumes everything it touches. Still our all-time leading scorer

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If DeMar DeRozan had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF DEMAR HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Growlithe. Extremely loyal, it barks at anything to protect its trainer. We drafted DeMar ninth in twenty oh nine, and he gave us nine seasons.
beats.dlg: EXTREMELY LOYAL.|#9 PICK, 9 SEASONS WITH US

beats.vo: Houndoom. The pack picks its leader by fighting it out. DeMar fought his way to four All-Star games with us, and started in twenty seventeen.
beats.dlg: THE PACK PICKS ITS LEADER.|4 ALL-STAR GAMES WITH US

beats.vo: Darmanitan. Its internal fire burns at twenty-five hundred degrees. New Year's Day, twenty eighteen: fifty-two points.
beats.dlg: ITS INNER FIRE BURNS HOT.|NEW YEAR'S DAY: 52 POINTS!

beats.vo: Boltund. It can run nonstop for three full days. By twenty eighteen, DeMar led our franchise in games, minutes and wins.
beats.dlg: IT RUNS NONSTOP FOR DAYS.|OUR LEADER IN GAMES, WINS

beats.vo: Lycanroc. Raised from a young age, it will never betray its trainer. Nine seasons he stayed loyal. Then, in July twenty eighteen, we traded him for Kawhi.
beats.dlg: NEVER BETRAYS ITS TRAINER.|2018: TRADED FOR KAWHI

beats.vo: And the ace. Entei. It blasts fire that consumes everything it touches. Nine seasons, and he's still our all-time leading scorer. Today he's a Nugget.
beats.dlg: ITS FIRE CONSUMES ALL.|STILL OUR ALL-TIME SCORER

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: DeRozan: selected ninth overall (No. 9) by Toronto in the 2009 draft; spent nine (9) seasons with the Raptors (2009-2018); All-Star 2014, 2016, 2017, 2018 with Toronto (four, 4X), named a starter for the 2017 All-Star Game; on January 1, 2018 (New Year's Day) scored a franchise-record 52 points vs Milwaukee; finished 2017-18 as the franchise leader in games played, wins and total minutes; traded to San Antonio for Kawhi Leonard on July 18, 2018; the franchise's all-time leading scorer; now with the Denver Nuggets
